decks.notes: This deck revolves around creating a powerful combo using Broodscale Bloodchief and various support cards to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Sowing Mycospawn, Glaring Fleshraker, and Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to generate tokens, control the board, and set up the conditions for a game-winning play with Broodscale Bloodchief. With ramp cards like Eldrazi Temple and Gemstone Caverns, the deck can quickly build up its resources to execute its combo efficiently. Additionally, cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga provide consistency and card selection to ensure the combo pieces come together effectively.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan through hand disruption and removal spells. It includes a variety of permanent and instant speed removal options to handle various threats on the board. The deck also uses creatures with powerful abilities to generate card advantage and maintain board presence. The land base includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. Overall, the deck aims to grind out the opponent and out-value them in the long game.

This deck focuses on using a combination of card draw, mana acceleration, and sacrifice effects to quickly power out a Cosmogoyf, a powerful creature that gets stronger the more types of cards are in graveyards. The deck aims to assemble the combo pieces needed to get the Cosmogoyf onto the battlefield as quickly as possible, potentially winning the game in just a few turns. Additional backup strategies include using Pact of Negation to protect the combo or using Fling or Thud to deal massive damage to the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing Teferi, Time Raveler and other planeswalkers to maintain board presence and card advantage. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds a unique synergy to the deck, providing additional support for your creatures. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing for a variety of plays to outmaneuver opponents. Overall, the deck prioritizes control elements to dictate the pace of the game and ensure victory through strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on assembling the Allosaurus Combo by using cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to cheat out powerful creatures like Ghalta and Griselbrand. Using effects like Consign to Memory and Pact of Negation to protect the combo, the deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with big creatures. The inclusion of cards like Atraxa and Veil of Summer provide additional utility and protection, while the lands and mana ramp from cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Bridgeworks Battle help ensure the deck can play its key cards efficiently.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to efficiently combo off and win the game. It utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for key creatures such as Devoted Druid and Walking Ballista, while Leyline of Abundance helps generate mana to fuel the combo. The inclusion of Agatha's Soul Cauldron provides additional resilience and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful finisher like Craterhoof Behemoth. The mana base is designed to support the toolbox strategy and ensure consistent performance.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently control the game with counterspells and disruption, while generating mana with cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention. The deck then aims to assemble the combo pieces of Goblin Charbelcher and Hydroelectric Specimen to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck has a focus on maximizing card advantage and using versatile cards like Stern Scolding and Into the Flood Maw to outmaneuver opponents. It is designed to be fast-paced and unpredictable, keeping opponents on their toes.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts, while utilizing the UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana quickly. Cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms provide additional control options and threats on the board. The inclusion of cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer help disrupt opponent's strategies, while also providing card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through efficient removal and powerful threats, utilizing the synergy between Eldrazi creatures and artifact cards.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through disrupting your opponent's hand and graveyard with cards like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus, while also dealing with threats on the board using removal spells like Prismatic Ending. Quantum Riddler and Ketramose, the New Dawn provide card advantage and help maintain control of the game. The deck also includes Ephemerate for additional value and protection for key creatures. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and attrition.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal damage quickly, while also incorporating burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart for additional reach. The deck also includes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to help dig for key cards. Overall, the strategy revolves around applying early pressure, keeping up tempo with cheap spells, and finishing off opponents with burn spells for a fast-paced aggressive playstyle.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to generate value and control the game. It aims to ramp up mana quickly, utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to play powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. Generating tokens with Blade of the Bloodchief and Basking Broodscale, and using removal spells like Unholy Heat and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. The deck also includes utility cards like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt opponent's strategies and maintain tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize creatures with abilities to search for and play other creatures from the deck, creating a toolbox of threats and answers. The deck aims to generate mana quickly with Leyline of Abundance and Devoted Druid, enabling explosive plays such as casting Craterhoof Behemoth for a game-winning attack. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional creature search and flexibility, while cards like Vizier of Remedies and Eternal Witness offer recursion and combo potential. Overall, the deck focuses on creature-based combos and synergy to overwhelm opponents.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption, card advantage, and removal to control the game. The deck includes a mix of counter spells, hand disruption, creature removal, and card draw. It aims to control the board by countering threats, removing creatures, and disrupting the opponent's game plan. By maintaining card advantage and staying ahead on resources, this deck can outlast opponents and win through incremental advantage. The deck also includes some card advantage engines such as Quantum Riddler and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian to help maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana and casting cheap spells to generate storm count, allowing for explosive turns where multiple spells can be cast in succession. The goal is to chain together spells with the help of Ruby Medallion and Ral, Monsoon Mage to generate enough mana and spells to win the game with a big Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with Past in Flames to recast spells and generate even more storm count. Wish cards provide additional versatility and options for the deck.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing cards like Street Wraith, Oliphaunt, and Waker of Waves to quickly fill up your graveyard with creatures. Once enough creatures are in the graveyard, you can cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming your opponent and gaining a significant advantage. Support cards like Shardless Agent, Subtlety, Endurance, and Force of Negation help provide control and protection, while cards like Violent Outburst and Generous Ent can help you quickly set up the combo. The deck aims to win through a powerful combo turn where you bring back a large number of creatures at once to overwhelm your opponent.

The main concept of this Living End combo deck is to quickly cycle through cards in order to fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. This strategy allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a large number of creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety. The deck focuses on controlling the board and winning through the advantage gained from the mass reanimation of creatures.
